title: Keystore plain_len multiply can overflow before malloc on 32-bit
description:
In wp11_keystore.c ~line 1181: plain_len = 5u + nkeys * (4300u + WP11_KEYSTORE_CERT_MAX + 16u). nkeys is validated against WP11_KEYSTORE_MAX_ENTRIES (64) but the guard is at the top of the function; the multiply itself has no overflow check. Per-entry size is ~8412 bytes; 64 * 8412 = ~538K which is safe on 64-bit, but on 32-bit SIZE_MAX is 4GB and with a large CERT_MAX this can wrap. Even on 64-bit, the validation could be bypassed by a future caller.

Fix: add explicit overflow check before the multiply. Add comment explaining the maximum-size calculation.
